resolve_rel() {  # resolve_rel <relpath> → first existing dir among the candidate roots
  local rel="$1" c
  if [[ "$rel" == /* ]]; then [[ -d "$rel" ]] && { printf '%s' "$rel"; return 0; }; return 1; fi
  for c in "$TASK_DIR/$rel" "$SUITE_ROOT/$rel" "$REPO_ROOT/$rel" "$REPO_ROOT/evals/fixtures/$rel" "$SOURCE_TREE/evals/fixtures/$rel"; do
    [[ -d "$c" ]] && { (cd "$c" && pwd); return 0; }
  done
  return 1
}
sgit() {  # git on the sandbox repo, isolated from the operator's git config
  env -i PATH="$PATH" HOME="$META" GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 LC_ALL=C \
    git -C "$WS" "$@"
}

if [[ "$KIND" == build ]]; then
  fx_rel="$(jq -r '.fixture // ""' <<<"$TASK_JSON")"
  [[ -n "$fx_rel" ]] || infra "build task has no fixture"
  FIXTURE_DIR="$(resolve_rel "$fx_rel")" || infra "fixture not found: $fx_rel"
  case "/$FIXTURE_DIR/" in */hidden/*) infra "fixture resolves inside a hidden directory: $fx_rel" ;; esac
  lib_call check_fixture_path_rule "$FIXTURE_DIR"
  cp -a "$FIXTURE_DIR/." "$WS/"
else
  fx_rel="$(jq -r '.review_catch.fixture // .fixture // ""' <<<"$TASK_JSON")"
  [[ -n "$fx_rel" ]] || infra "review-catch task has no review_catch.fixture"
  FIXTURE_DIR="$(resolve_rel "$fx_rel")" || infra "review-catch fixture not found: $fx_rel"
  mkdir -p "$WS/pr"
  for p in base head head.diff PR.md REVIEW-INSTRUCTIONS.md AUDIT-INSTRUCTIONS.md; do
    [[ -e "$FIXTURE_DIR/$p" ]] && cp -a "$FIXTURE_DIR/$p" "$WS/pr/"
  done
  [[ -f "$WS/pr/head.diff" ]] || infra "review-catch fixture has no head.diff: $fx_rel"
fi

# base commit: the fixture tree only; the mount paths are excluded so the gates'
# diff (base..HEAD) and the snapshots carry the agent's work, not the harness.
sgit init -q
sgit config user.name eval
sgit config user.email eval@loa
sgit config commit.gpgsign false
{
  printf '%s\n' '/.claude/' '/CLAUDE.md' '/.loa.config.yaml' '/grimoires/' '/.run/' '/.beads/' '/.eval/'
} >> "$WS/.git/info/exclude"
sgit add -A
sgit commit -q --allow-empty -m base
BASE_COMMIT="$(sgit rev-parse HEAD)"
printf 'base_commit=%s\n' "$BASE_COMMIT" >> "$ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE"

if [[ "$LOA_MOUNT" == true ]]; then
  lib_call mount_prompt_surface "$WS" "$SOURCE_TREE" -
fi
lib_call apply_arm_toggles "$WS" "$TOGGLES" "$ARM"
if [[ "$LOA_MOUNT" == true ]]; then
  lib_call write_sandbox_grimoire "$WS" "$TASK_YAML" "$ARM" "$SPRINT"
  lib_call init_sandbox_beads "$WS" "$(jq -r '.title // .id' <<<"$TASK_JSON")"
  mkdir -p "$WS/.run"
  [[ -e "$WS/.run/zone-guard-authorization.json" ]] && infra "sandbox carries .run/zone-guard-authorization.json"
  lib_call regen_sandbox_manifest "$WS"
  grep -q '^manifest_sha256=' "$ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE" || infra "regen_sandbox_manifest printed no manifest_sha256"
else
  [[ -e "$WS/.claude" || -e "$WS/CLAUDE.md" ]] && infra "loa_mount: false but the sandbox has .claude/ or CLAUDE.md"
  printf 'loa_mount=none\n' >> "$ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE"
fi
mkdir -p "$WS/.eval/tmp" "$WS/.eval/gh-empty"
: > "$WS/.eval/model-invoke.jsonl"
: > "$WS/.eval/cost-ledger.jsonl"

# --- leak guards (AC-4.2, AC-5.5) ----------------------------------------------------
hidden_hit="$(cd "$WS" && find . -path ./.git -prune -o -path ./.claude -prune -o \
  \( -iname hidden -o -iname 'hidden-tests' -o -iname 'hidden.*' \) -print | sed -n '1p')"
[[ -z "$hidden_hit" ]] || infra "sandbox contains a hidden path: ${hidden_hit#./}"
arm_hit="$(grep -rIl --exclude-dir=.git -F -e "$ARM" "$WS" 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1p' || true)"
[[ -z "$arm_hit" ]] || infra "arm id appears in the sandbox: ${arm_hit#"$WS"/}"

leak_scan() {  # leak_scan <file> — `hidden`, a defect key or any arm id → non-zero
  local f="$1" id
  grep -qi 'hidden' "$f" && { echo "the word hidden"; return 1; }
  grep -qE 'D[0-9]{2}-' "$f" && { echo "a defect key"; return 1; }
  while IFS= read -r id; do
    [[ -n "$id" ]] || continue
    grep -qF -e "$id" "$f" && { echo "arm id $id"; return 1; }
  done <<<"$ALL_ARM_IDS"
  return 0
}
if [[ -f "$WS/grimoires/loa/context/task-brief.md" ]]; then
  why="$(leak_scan "$WS/grimoires/loa/context/task-brief.md")" || infra "task-brief.md leaks $why"
fi

# --- prompts (D-4.4) -----------------------------------------------------------------
subst() {  # subst <text> <key> <value>
  local text="$1" key="{{$2}}" val="$3"
  printf '%s' "${text//"$key"/$val}"
}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# evals/harness/lib/sandbox-mount.sh — sandbox materialisation and arm toggles
#
# cycle-130 Sprint 258 Task 1.6 (SDD D-4.5, DEC-0421, DEC-0423, DEC-0396).
# Extracted from execute-agent.sh (cycle-129 step 2 and the toggle functions)
# WITHOUT behaviour change for the cycle-129 single-skill path, and shared with
# pipeline-run.sh. Source it; it defines functions only and sets no shell
# options (the caller runs under `set -euo pipefail`).
#
# Contract (every function returns 0 on success, 2 when refused / when a step
# cannot take effect; refusals name the reason on one stderr line):
#
#   mount_prompt_surface <ws> <prompt_tree> <skill|->
#       skill given: <ws>/.claude/skills/<skill>/ (whole dir), .claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md,
#       .claude/rules/, CLAUDE.md = "@.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md"; the prompt tree's
#       .loa.config.yaml only in arm mode (LOA_EVAL_ARM set), as cycle-129 did.
#       skill "-": the whole .claude/ tree is copied (files, never a symlink to the
#       tree), CLAUDE.md as above, and .loa.config.yaml always (the pipeline
#       executor needs every skill, hook and script). Evidence: mount=skill:<s>|tree.
#   resolve_arm_toggles <arm> <suite_file>
#       prints the arm's toggles as compact JSON on stdout. Arms are read from
#       `.arms[]` (ablation-2.0) and `.ab.arms[]` (recall suites). An arm with
#       toggles {} (a1_full, baseline) prints {}; `baseline` undeclared prints {}.
#       Exit 2: undeclared arm (an unreadable suite file declares none), `absent: true` arm.
#   apply_arm_toggles <ws> <toggles_json> <arm>
#       applies every toggle to the SANDBOX COPY and verifies it afterwards; exit 2
#       when one cannot take effect or is unknown. Toggles and values:
#         companion_voice: false  flatline_protocol.{code_review,security_audit}.companion_voice=false
#         karpathy_block: false   '## Karpathy Principles' out of CLAUDE.loa.md (+ constraints.json rows)
#         rule_files: false       stash-safety.md, skill-invariants.md out of .claude/rules/
#         audit_delta_instruction: false  the delta paragraph out of auditing-security/SKILL.md
#         loa_mount: false        verifies no .claude/, CLAUDE.md, .loa.config.yaml in <ws>
#                                 (the caller skips mount_prompt_surface); evidence loa_mount=none
#         effort: low|medium|high|xhigh|max
#                                 every `effort:` line out of the frontmatter of every
#                                 <ws>/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md; every `default_effort` key in
#                                 <ws>/.claude/defaults/model-config.yaml set to the value and its
#                                 .checksum (bare sha256 hex) refreshed when present.
#                                 The caller passes `--effort <v>` on argv.
#         gates: false            flatline_protocol.{code_review,security_audit}.enabled=false;
#                                 LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false exported in the CALLING shell
#                                 and written to $ARM_ENV_FILE (KEY=VALUE lines) when that is set
#         flatline: false         flatline_protocol.enabled=false
#         sprint_plan: false, context_resets: false
#                                 phase-set edits owned by the pipeline executor; recorded as
#                                 evidence here (the single-skill executor refuses them itself)
#   regen_sandbox_manifest <ws>
#       writes <ws>/.claude/checksums.json {generated, algorithm: sha256, files} over
#       every regular file under <ws>/.claude except overrides/ and the manifest
#       itself (LC_ALL=C order, sha256). tools/gen-checksums.sh (in the
#       prompt tree, $EVAL_PROMPT_TREE) is used instead when it exists AND <ws> is a
#       git repository tracking .claude files (it lists `git ls-files`). No .claude/
#       (loa_mount: false) → manifest_sha256=none, exit 0. Prints manifest_sha256=<hex>.
#   check_fixture_path_rule <fixture_dir>
#       exit 2 (offending paths on stderr) when the fixture's top level holds
#       .claude, CLAUDE.md, .loa.config.yaml, grimoires or .run — the mount owns
#       those paths (DEC-0396); exit 0 otherwise.
#   write_sandbox_grimoire <ws> <task_yaml> <arm> <sprint_label>
#       grimoires/loa/ledger.json (one active cycle, <sprint_label> planned, global 1;
#       the ledger-lib.sh schema), NOTES.md (header only), context/task-brief.md (the
#       task's agent-facing `criterion` + the TASK.md next to task.yaml),
#       a2a/<sprint_label>/ (empty); review-catch tasks also get a one-sprint
#       grimoires/loa/sprint.md naming pr/head.diff and a2a/<sprint_label>/reviewer.md
#       carrying pr/PR.md (sandbox copy, else the corpus fixture's). An arm whose
#       toggles carry sprint_plan: false (resolved from $LOA_EVAL_SUITE_FILE, default
#       evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml) gets NO sprint.md. Build tasks leave sprint.md
#       to the PLAN phase. Nothing written names the arm.
#   init_sandbox_beads <ws> <task_title>
#       `br init --prefix bd --no-daemon` in <ws> plus one task bead with the title
#       when br ($LOA_EVAL_BR_BIN, default br) is on PATH → beads=br; else the opt-out
#       marker through <ws>/.claude/scripts/beads/update-beads-state.sh --opt-out →
#       beads=opt-out; neither → beads=none (exit 0).
#
# Hashing is Python hashlib (_sm_sha256), never .claude/ code: see _sm_sha256.
# Callers source this file by a literal relative path (no variable expansion
# on the source line), as eval.yml's trust-boundary scan requires.
#
# Evidence: every function reports `key=value` lines (one line, no newline in
# the value). When ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE is set they are appended to that file;
# else they go to the descriptor in SANDBOX_MOUNT_EVIDENCE_FD (default 1).
# resolve_arm_toggles prints JSON on stdout and no evidence.
#
# Tested by evals/tests/arm-toggles.bats (directly and through execute-agent.sh)
# and evals/tests/execute-agent.bats.
# =============================================================================

[[ "${_SANDBOX_MOUNT_LOADED:-}" == "true" ]] && return 0
_SANDBOX_MOUNT_LOADED=true

_SM_LIB_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
_SM_REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$_SM_LIB_DIR/../../.." && pwd)"

_sm_err() { echo "ERROR: $*" >&2; }

# _sm_sha256 <file>... prints "<hex>  <file>" lines, the sha256sum output shape.
# Python hashlib, not compat-lib's sha256_portable: the eval workflow runs the
# harness as the trusted copy against a PR's .claude/, so no harness script
# sources .claude/ code (eval.yml "Validate grader trust boundary"); run-arms.sh
# hashes the corpus the same way.
_sm_sha256() {
  python3 -I -c '
import hashlib, sys
for p in sys.argv[1:]:
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(p, "rb") as f:
        for b in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
            h.update(b)
    print(h.hexdigest() + "  " + p)' "$@"
}

# _sm_evidence <key> <value> — one key=value line to the evidence sink.
_sm_evidence() {
  local line="$1=${2//$'\n'/ }"
  if [[ -n "${ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE:-}" ]]; then
    printf '%s\n' "$line" >> "$ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE"
  else
    local fd="${SANDBOX_MOUNT_EVIDENCE_FD:-1}"
    [[ "$fd" =~ ^[0-9]$ ]] || fd=1
    printf '%s\n' "$line" >&"$fd"
  fi
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
mount_prompt_surface() {
  local ws="$1" tree="$2" skill="${3:-}"
  [[ -d "$ws" ]] || { _sm_err "mount_prompt_surface: workspace not found: $ws"; return 2; }
  [[ -d "$tree/.claude" ]] || { _sm_err "mount_prompt_surface: prompt tree has no .claude/: $tree"; return 2; }
  if [[ "$skill" == "-" ]]; then
    mkdir -p "$ws/.claude"
    cp -a "$tree/.claude/." "$ws/.claude/" || { _sm_err "mount_prompt_surface: copying .claude/ failed"; return 2; }
    printf '@.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md\n' > "$ws/CLAUDE.md"
    if [[ -f "$tree/.loa.config.yaml" ]]; then cp "$tree/.loa.config.yaml" "$ws/.loa.config.yaml"; fi
    _sm_evidence mount "tree"
    return 0
  fi
  case "$skill" in */*|.*|'') _sm_err "invalid skill name '$skill'"; return 2 ;; esac
  local skill_src="$tree/.claude/skills/$skill"
  [[ -f "$skill_src/SKILL.md" ]] || { _sm_err "prompt tree $tree has no .claude/skills/$skill/SKILL.md"; return 2; }
  mkdir -p "$ws/.claude/skills" "$ws/.claude/loa"
  # Whole skill dir (resources included) so guarded reads inside the skill resolve.
  local skill_dst="$ws/.claude/skills/$skill"
  mkdir -p "$skill_dst"
  cp -a "$skill_src/." "$skill_dst/"
  if [[ -f "$tree/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md" ]]; then
    cp "$tree/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md" "$ws/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md"
  fi
  if [[ -d "$tree/.claude/rules" ]]; then
    mkdir -p "$ws/.claude/rules"
    cp -a "$tree/.claude/rules/." "$ws/.claude/rules/"
  fi
  printf '@.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md\n' > "$ws/CLAUDE.md"
  if [[ -n "${LOA_EVAL_ARM+x}" && -f "$tree/.loa.config.yaml" ]]; then
    cp "$tree/.loa.config.yaml" "$ws/.loa.config.yaml"
  fi
  _sm_evidence mount "skill:$skill"
  return 0
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
resolve_arm_toggles() {
  local arm="$1" suite_file="${2:-}"
  [[ "$arm" =~ ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$ ]] || { _sm_err "invalid arm id '$arm'"; return 2; }
  local found=0 entry=""
  if [[ -n "$suite_file" && -f "$suite_file" ]]; then
    # an unreadable suite file reads as "not declared" (cycle-129 behaviour: baseline still resolves to {})
    entry="$(ARM="$arm" yq -o=json -I=0 '[((.arms // [])[]), ((.ab.arms // [])[])] | map(select(.id == strenv(ARM))) | .[0] // null' "$suite_file" 2>/dev/null)" \
      || entry=""
    [[ -n "$entry" && "$entry" != "null" ]] && found=1
  fi
  if [[ "$found" -eq 0 ]]; then
    [[ "$arm" == "baseline" ]] && { printf '{}'; return 0; }
    _sm_err "arm '$arm' is not declared in ${suite_file:-any suite} (arms[] / ab.arms[])"
    return 2
  fi
  if [[ "$(jq -r '.absent // false' <<<"$entry")" == "true" ]]; then
    _sm_err "arm '$arm' is declared absent in $suite_file (never run): $(jq -r '.evidence // "no evidence"' <<<"$entry")"
    return 2
  fi
  local t
  t="$(jq -c '.toggles // {}' <<<"$entry")"
  jq -e 'type == "object"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$t" || { _sm_err "arm '$arm' toggles are not an object in $suite_file"; return 2; }
  printf '%s' "$t"
}

# Remove the markdown section that starts at the exact heading line $2 (up to
# the next level-2 heading) from file $1. Prints the number of lines removed.
_sm_drop_md_section() {
  local f="$1" heading="$2" tmpdir="$3" tmp
  tmp="$(mktemp "$tmpdir/.arm.XXXXXX")"
  awk -v h="$heading" '
    $0 == h { skip = 1; n++; next }
    skip && /^## / { skip = 0 }
    skip { n++; next }
    { print }
    END { print n + 0 > "/dev/stderr" }' "$f" > "$tmp" 2> "$tmp.n"
  mv "$tmp" "$f"
  cat "$tmp.n"; rm -f "$tmp.n"
}

# Remove the first blank-line-delimited paragraph of $1 that contains one of
# the needles (tried in order, case-insensitive). Writes the removed text to
# $2; exit 1 when no needle matches.
_sm_drop_paragraph() {
  python3 -I - "$1" "$2" "look for what the review did not" "Confirm the review's demotions independently" <<'PY'
import re, sys
path, out = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
text = open(path, encoding="utf-8").read()
paras = re.split(r"(\n[ \t]*\n)", text)
for needle in sys.argv[3:]:
    for i in range(0, len(paras), 2):
        if needle.lower() in paras[i].lower():
            removed = paras[i]
            # drop the paragraph and the separator that follows it
            del paras[i:i + 2]
            open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8").write("".join(paras))
            open(out, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(removed + "\n")
            sys.exit(0)
sys.exit(1)
PY
}

# Strip every `effort:` line from the YAML frontmatter of file $1 (frontmatter
# = line 1 `---` up to the next `---`). Prints 1 when a line was removed, else 0.
_sm_strip_frontmatter_effort() {
  local f="$1" tmp
  tmp="$(mktemp "$f.XXXXXX")"
  awk '
    NR == 1 && $0 == "---" { fm = 1; print; next }
    fm == 1 && $0 == "---" { fm = 2; print; next }
    fm == 1 && /^effort:/ { n++; next }
    { print }
    END { print (n > 0 ? 1 : 0) > "/dev/stderr" }' "$f" > "$tmp" 2> "$tmp.n"
  cat "$tmp" > "$f"; rm -f "$tmp"
  cat "$tmp.n"; rm -f "$tmp.n"
}

# 0 when file $1's frontmatter still carries an `effort:` line.
_sm_frontmatter_has_effort() {
  awk 'NR == 1 && $0 != "---" { exit 1 } NR > 1 && $0 == "---" { exit 1 } NR > 1 && /^effort:/ { found = 1; exit 0 } END { exit (found ? 0 : 1) }' "$1"
}

_sm_cfg_set_false() {  # _sm_cfg_set_false <cfg> <yq-path>... ; verifies each
  local cfg="$1"; shift
  [[ -f "$cfg" ]] || : > "$cfg"
  local p
  for p in "$@"; do
    P="$p" yq -i 'eval(strenv(P)) = false' "$cfg" 2>/dev/null || return 1
    [[ "$(P="$p" yq -r 'eval(strenv(P))' "$cfg" 2>/dev/null)" == "false" ]] || return 1
  done
  return 0
}

apply_arm_toggles() {
  local ws="$1" toggles="${2:-}" arm="${3:-}"
  [[ -d "$ws" ]] || { _sm_err "apply_arm_toggles: workspace not found: $ws"; return 2; }
  [[ -n "$toggles" ]] || toggles='{}'
  jq -e 'type == "object"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$toggles" || { _sm_err "arm '$arm' toggles are not a JSON object"; return 2; }
  local eval_dir="$ws/.eval"
  mkdir -p "$eval_dir"
  local key val
  while IFS=$'\t' read -r key val; do
    [[ -n "$key" ]] || continue
    if [[ "$key" == "effort" ]]; then
      case "$val" in low|medium|high|xhigh|max) ;; *) _sm_err "arm '$arm' toggle effort=$val (want low|medium|high|xhigh|max)"; return 2 ;; esac
    elif [[ "$val" != "false" ]]; then
      _sm_err "arm '$arm' toggle $key=$val (only false is defined)"; return 2
    fi
    case "$key" in
      companion_voice)
        _sm_cfg_set_false "$ws/.loa.config.yaml" .flatline_protocol.code_review.companion_voice .flatline_protocol.security_audit.companion_voice \
          || { _sm_err "companion_voice toggle did not take effect"; return 2; }
        _sm_evidence companion_voice "flatline_protocol.{code_review,security_audit}.companion_voice=false"
        ;;
      karpathy_block)
        local k="$ws/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md" n
        [[ -f "$k" ]] || { _sm_err "karpathy_block toggle: no sandbox CLAUDE.loa.md"; return 2; }
        n="$(_sm_drop_md_section "$k" '## Karpathy Principles' "$eval_dir")"
        if [[ "${n:-0}" -eq 0 ]] || grep -q '^## Karpathy Principles' "$k"; then
          _sm_err "karpathy_block toggle: no '## Karpathy Principles' section removed"; return 2
        fi
        local cj="$ws/.claude/data/constraints.json" cjn="none"
        if [[ -f "$cj" ]]; then
          # audit r1 DISS-C-008: a failed rewrite is exit 2, not a silent pass; verify afterwards
          jq '(.constraints // []) |= map(select((tostring | test("karpathy"; "i")) | not))' "$cj" > "$cj.tmp" \
            || { rm -f "$cj.tmp"; _sm_err "karpathy_block toggle: constraints.json could not be rewritten"; return 2; }
          mv "$cj.tmp" "$cj"
          cjn="$(jq '[(.constraints // [])[] | select(tostring | test("karpathy"; "i"))] | length' "$cj" 2>/dev/null || echo "?")"
          [[ "$cjn" == "0" ]] || { _sm_err "karpathy_block toggle: constraints.json still carries Karpathy rows ($cjn)"; return 2; }
        fi
        _sm_evidence karpathy_block "removed ${n} lines from CLAUDE.loa.md; constraints.json karpathy rows after: ${cjn}"
        ;;
      rule_files)
        local r gone=""
        for r in stash-safety.md skill-invariants.md; do
          if [[ -e "$ws/.claude/rules/$r" ]]; then rm -f "$ws/.claude/rules/$r"; gone="$gone $r"; fi
          [[ ! -e "$ws/.claude/rules/$r" ]] || { _sm_err "rule_files toggle: $r still present"; return 2; }
        done
        _sm_evidence rule_files "removed:${gone:- none present}"
        ;;
      audit_delta_instruction)
        local s="$ws/.claude/skills/auditing-security/SKILL.md"
        [[ -f "$s" ]] || { _sm_err "audit_delta_instruction toggle: no sandbox auditing-security/SKILL.md"; return 2; }
        _sm_drop_paragraph "$s" "$eval_dir/arm-removed.txt" \
          || { _sm_err "audit_delta_instruction toggle: no delta paragraph found in the sandbox SKILL.md"; return 2; }
        _sm_evidence audit_delta_instruction "removed $(wc -c < "$eval_dir/arm-removed.txt" | tr -d ' ') bytes (.eval/arm-removed.txt)"
        ;;
      loa_mount)
        local p left=""
        for p in .claude CLAUDE.md .loa.config.yaml; do
          if [[ -e "$ws/$p" || -L "$ws/$p" ]]; then left="$left $p"; fi
        done
        [[ -z "$left" ]] || { _sm_err "loa_mount toggle: the sandbox still holds:$left (mount_prompt_surface must be skipped)"; return 2; }
        _sm_evidence loa_mount "none"
        ;;
      effort)
        local f total=0 stripped=0 still=""
        for f in "$ws"/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md; do
          [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue
          total=$((total + 1))
          if [[ "$(_sm_strip_frontmatter_effort "$f")" == "1" ]]; then stripped=$((stripped + 1)); fi
          if _sm_frontmatter_has_effort "$f"; then still="$still ${f#"$ws"/}"; fi
        done
        [[ -z "$still" ]] || { _sm_err "effort toggle: effort: still in the frontmatter of:$still"; return 2; }
        local mc="$ws/.claude/defaults/model-config.yaml" cat_state="absent"
        if [[ -f "$mc" ]]; then
          local nkeys
          nkeys="$(yq '[.. | select(tag == "!!map" and has("default_effort"))] | length' "$mc" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
          [[ "$nkeys" =~ ^[0-9]+$ && "$nkeys" -gt 0 ]] \
            || { _sm_err "effort toggle: no default_effort key in the sandbox model-config.yaml"; return 2; }
          V="$val" yq -i '(.. | select(tag == "!!map" and has("default_effort")) | .default_effort) = strenv(V)' "$mc" \
            || { _sm_err "effort toggle: yq failed on the sandbox model-config.yaml"; return 2; }
          local wrong
          wrong="$(V="$val" yq '[.. | select(tag == "!!map" and has("default_effort")) | select(.default_effort != strenv(V))] | length' "$mc" 2>/dev/null || echo 1)"
          [[ "$wrong" == "0" ]] || { _sm_err "effort toggle: default_effort did not take effect"; return 2; }
          cat_state="default_effort=$val in $nkeys entries"
          if [[ -f "$mc.checksum" ]]; then
            local h
            h="$(_sm_sha256 "$mc" | awk '{print $1}')"
            [[ "$h" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]] || { _sm_err "effort toggle: could not hash model-config.yaml"; return 2; }
            printf '%s\n' "$h" > "$mc.checksum"
            cat_state="$cat_state; .checksum refreshed"
          fi
        fi
        _sm_evidence effort "$val"
        _sm_evidence effort_skills_stripped "$stripped/$total"
        _sm_evidence effort_catalog "$cat_state"
        ;;
      gates)
        _sm_cfg_set_false "$ws/.loa.config.yaml" .flatline_protocol.code_review.enabled .flatline_protocol.security_audit.enabled \
          || { _sm_err "gates toggle did not take effect"; return 2; }
        export LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false
        if [[ -n "${ARM_ENV_FILE:-}" ]]; then printf 'LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false\n' >> "$ARM_ENV_FILE"; fi
        _sm_evidence gates "flatline_protocol.{code_review,security_audit}.enabled=false"
        _sm_evidence arm_env "LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false"
        ;;
      flatline)
        _sm_cfg_set_false "$ws/.loa.config.yaml" .flatline_protocol.enabled \
          || { _sm_err "flatline toggle did not take effect"; return 2; }
        _sm_evidence flatline "flatline_protocol.enabled=false"
        ;;
      sprint_plan)
        _sm_evidence sprint_plan "phase set without PLAN (pipeline executor); no sprint.md materialised"
        ;;
      context_resets)
        _sm_evidence context_resets "implementer phases continue one session (pipeline executor)"
        ;;
      *) _sm_err "arm '$arm' declares unknown toggle '$key'"; return 2 ;;
    esac
  done < <(jq -r 'to_entries[] | [.key, (.value | tostring)] | @tsv' <<<"$toggles")
  return 0
}

regen_sandbox_manifest() {
  local ws="$1"
  [[ -d "$ws" ]] || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: workspace not found: $ws"; return 2; }
  if [[ ! -d "$ws/.claude" ]]; then
    _sm_evidence manifest_sha256 "none"
    return 0
  fi
  local out="$ws/.claude/checksums.json" tool="${EVAL_PROMPT_TREE:-$_SM_REPO_ROOT}/tools/gen-checksums.sh" how="inline"
  if [[ -x "$tool" ]] && git -C "$ws" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 \
     && [[ -n "$(git -C "$ws" ls-files .claude 2>/dev/null | head -1)" ]]; then
    "$tool" --root "$ws" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: $tool --root $ws failed"; return 2; }
    how="gen-checksums.sh"
  else
    local list="$ws/.eval/.manifest-files" sums="$ws/.eval/.manifest-sums"
    mkdir -p "$ws/.eval"
    ( cd "$ws" && find .claude -type f ! -path '.claude/overrides/*' ! -path '.claude/checksums.json' -print ) \
      | LC_ALL=C sort > "$list"
    if grep -q '\\' "$list"; then _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: a path under .claude/ holds a backslash"; rm -f "$list"; return 2; fi
    : > "$sums"
    local -a batch=()
    local f
    while IFS= read -r f; do
      batch+=("$f")
      if [[ ${#batch[@]} -ge 200 ]]; then
        ( cd "$ws" && _sm_sha256 "${batch[@]}" ) >> "$sums" || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: hashing failed"; return 2; }
        batch=()
      fi
    done < "$list"
    if [[ ${#batch[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
      ( cd "$ws" && _sm_sha256 "${batch[@]}" ) >> "$sums" || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: hashing failed"; return 2; }
    fi
    jq -Rn --arg generated "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" '
      {generated: $generated, algorithm: "sha256",
       files: ([inputs | select(length > 0) | capture("^(?<h>[0-9a-f]{64})  (?<p>.+)$") | {key: .p, value: .h}] | from_entries)}' \
      < "$sums" > "$out.tmp" || { rm -f "$out.tmp" "$list" "$sums"; _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: could not write the manifest"; return 2; }
    mv "$out.tmp" "$out"
    rm -f "$list" "$sums"
  fi
  jq -e '.files | type == "object"' "$out" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: $out is not a manifest"; return 2; }
  local digest
  digest="$(_sm_sha256 "$out" | awk '{print $1}')"
  _sm_evidence manifest_files "$(jq '.files | length' "$out") ($how)"
  _sm_evidence manifest_sha256 "$digest"
  return 0
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
check_fixture_path_rule() {
  local dir="$1"
  [[ -d "$dir" ]] || { _sm_err "check_fixture_path_rule: fixture not found: $dir"; return 2; }
  local p bad=""
  for p in .claude CLAUDE.md .loa.config.yaml grimoires .run; do
    if [[ -e "$dir/$p" || -L "$dir/$p" ]]; then bad="$bad $p"; fi
  done
  if [[ -n "$bad" ]]; then
    echo "fixture path rule: $dir holds paths the Loa mount owns:$bad" >&2
    return 2
  fi
  return 0
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
write_sandbox_grimoire() {
  local ws="$1" task="$2" arm="$3" label="${4:-sprint-1}"
  [[ -d "$ws" ]] || { _sm_err "write_sandbox_grimoire: workspace not found: $ws"; return 2; }
  [[ -f "$task" ]] || { _sm_err "write_sandbox_grimoire: task yaml not found: $task"; return 2; }
  [[ "$label" =~ ^sprint-[0-9]{1,4}$ ]] || { _sm_err "write_sandbox_grimoire: invalid sprint label '$label'"; return 2; }
  local tid ttype criterion task_md
  tid="$(yq -r '.id // ""' "$task")"; ttype="$(yq -r '.type // ""' "$task")"
  criterion="$(yq -r '.criterion // ""' "$task")"
  [[ "$tid" =~ ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,63}$ ]] || { _sm_err "write_sandbox_grimoire: task id '$tid' invalid"; return 2; }
  [[ -n "$criterion" && "$criterion" != "null" ]] || { _sm_err "write_sandbox_grimoire: task $tid has no criterion"; return 2; }
  task_md="$(dirname "$task")/TASK.md"
  [[ -f "$task_md" ]] || { _sm_err "write_sandbox_grimoire: no TASK.md beside $task"; return 2; }

  local sprint_plan=true
  if [[ -n "$arm" ]]; then
    local sf="${LOA_EVAL_SUITE_FILE:-$_SM_REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml}" tg
    if tg="$(resolve_arm_toggles "$arm" "$sf" 2>/dev/null)"; then
      [[ "$(jq -r 'if has("sprint_plan") then (.sprint_plan | tostring) else "true" end' <<<"$tg")" == "false" ]] && sprint_plan=false
    fi
  fi

  local g="$ws/grimoires/loa" now
  now="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
  mkdir -p "$g/context" "$g/a2a/$label"
  jq -n --arg now "$now" --arg label "$label" --arg tid "$tid" '
    {version: 1, schema_version: 1, created: $now, last_updated: $now,
     next_sprint_number: 2, global_sprint_counter: 1, active_cycle: "cycle-001",
     cycles: [{id: "cycle-001", label: ("eval task " + $tid), status: "active", created: $now,
               archived: null, archive_path: null, prd: null, sdd: null,
               sprints: [{global_id: 1, local_label: $label, status: "planned", created: $now, completed: null}]}],
     bugfixes: [], bugfix_cycles: []}' > "$g/ledger.json" \
    || { _sm_err "write_sandbox_grimoire: ledger write failed"; return 2; }
  printf '# NOTES\n' > "$g/NOTES.md"
  {
    printf '# Task brief\n\n## Criterion\n\n%s\n\n## Task\n\n' "$criterion"
    cat "$task_md"
  } > "$g/context/task-brief.md"
  local wrote="ledger.json NOTES.md context/task-brief.md a2a/$label/"

  if [[ "$ttype" == "review-catch" && "$sprint_plan" == "true" ]]; then
    {
      printf '# Sprint Plan\n\n## Sprint %s: Review the pull request in pr/\n\n' "${label#sprint-}"
      printf 'The change under review is `pr/head.diff` (unified diff, base to head). The files before the change are under `pr/base/`, after it under `pr/head/`; `pr/PR.md` is the pull request description and is the implementation report for this sprint.\n\n'
      printf '### Tasks\n\n- [x] Task 1.1: the change in `pr/head.diff`\n\n'
      printf '### Review scope\n\nThe gates review `pr/head.diff` (pass `--diff-file pr/head.diff` to the adversarial review). Cite findings as `head/<path>:<line>` with lines from the `pr/head/` files.\n\n'
      printf '## Success Criteria\n\n%s\n' "$criterion"
    } > "$g/sprint.md"
    local prmd="$ws/pr/PR.md" rcfx
    if [[ ! -f "$prmd" ]]; then
      rcfx="$(yq -r '.review_catch.fixture // ""' "$task")"
      case "$rcfx" in *..*|/*) rcfx="" ;; esac
      prmd="$_SM_REPO_ROOT/evals/fixtures/$rcfx/PR.md"
    fi
    [[ -f "$prmd" ]] || { _sm_err "write_sandbox_grimoire: no PR.md for review-catch task $tid"; return 2; }
    { printf '# Implementation Report: %s\n\n' "$label"; cat "$prmd"; } > "$g/a2a/$label/reviewer.md"
    wrote="$wrote sprint.md a2a/$label/reviewer.md"
  fi
  _sm_evidence grimoire "$wrote"
  return 0
}

init_sandbox_beads() {
  local ws="$1" title="${2:-}"
  [[ -d "$ws" ]] || { _sm_err "init_sandbox_beads: workspace not found: $ws"; return 2; }
  [[ -n "$title" ]] || title="eval task"
  local br="${LOA_EVAL_BR_BIN:-br}"
  if command -v "$br" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    ( cd "$ws" && "$br" init --prefix bd --no-daemon >/dev/null 2>&1 && "$br" create "$title" --type task --silent >/dev/null 2>&1 ) \
      || { _sm_err "init_sandbox_beads: br init/create failed in $ws"; return 2; }
    _sm_evidence beads "br"
    return 0
  fi
  local ubs="$ws/.claude/scripts/beads/update-beads-state.sh"
  if [[ -f "$ubs" ]]; then
    PROJECT_ROOT="$ws" bash "$ubs" --opt-out "eval sandbox: br not on PATH" >/dev/null 2>&1 \
      || { _sm_err "init_sandbox_beads: update-beads-state.sh --opt-out failed"; return 2; }
    _sm_evidence beads "opt-out"
    return 0
  fi
  _sm_evidence beads "none"
  return 0
}

[[ "${_SANDBOX_MOUNT_LOADED:-}" == "true" ]] && return 0
_SANDBOX_MOUNT_LOADED=true

_SM_LIB_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
_SM_REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$_SM_LIB_DIR/../../.." && pwd)"

_sm_err() { echo "ERROR: $*" >&2; }

# _sm_sha256 <file>... prints "<hex>  <file>" lines, the sha256sum output shape.
# Python hashlib, not compat-lib's sha256_portable: the eval workflow runs the
# harness as the trusted copy against a PR's .claude/, so no harness script
# sources .claude/ code (eval.yml "Validate grader trust boundary"); run-arms.sh
# hashes the corpus the same way.
_sm_sha256() {
  python3 -I -c '
import hashlib, sys
for p in sys.argv[1:]:
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(p, "rb") as f:
        for b in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
            h.update(b)
    print(h.hexdigest() + "  " + p)' "$@"
}

# _sm_evidence <key> <value> — one key=value line to the evidence sink.
_sm_evidence() {
  local line="$1=${2//$'\n'/ }"
  if [[ -n "${ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE:-}" ]]; then
    printf '%s\n' "$line" >> "$ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE"
  else
    local fd="${SANDBOX_MOUNT_EVIDENCE_FD:-1}"
    [[ "$fd" =~ ^[0-9]$ ]] || fd=1
    printf '%s\n' "$line" >&"$fd"
  fi
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
mount_prompt_surface() {
  local ws="$1" tree="$2" skill="${3:-}"
  [[ -d "$ws" ]] || { _sm_err "mount_prompt_surface: workspace not found: $ws"; return 2; }
  [[ -d "$tree/.claude" ]] || { _sm_err "mount_prompt_surface: prompt tree has no .claude/: $tree"; return 2; }
  if [[ "$skill" == "-" ]]; then
    mkdir -p "$ws/.claude"
    cp -a "$tree/.claude/." "$ws/.claude/" || { _sm_err "mount_prompt_surface: copying .claude/ failed"; return 2; }
    printf '@.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md\n' > "$ws/CLAUDE.md"
    if [[ -f "$tree/.loa.config.yaml" ]]; then cp "$tree/.loa.config.yaml" "$ws/.loa.config.yaml"; fi
    _sm_evidence mount "tree"
    return 0
  fi
  case "$skill" in */*|.*|'') _sm_err "invalid skill name '$skill'"; return 2 ;; esac
  local skill_src="$tree/.claude/skills/$skill"
  [[ -f "$skill_src/SKILL.md" ]] || { _sm_err "prompt tree $tree has no .claude/skills/$skill/SKILL.md"; return 2; }
  mkdir -p "$ws/.claude/skills" "$ws/.claude/loa"
  # Whole skill dir (resources included) so guarded reads inside the skill resolve.
  local skill_dst="$ws/.claude/skills/$skill"
  mkdir -p "$skill_dst"
  cp -a "$skill_src/." "$skill_dst/"
  if [[ -f "$tree/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md" ]]; then
    cp "$tree/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md" "$ws/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md"
  fi
  if [[ -d "$tree/.claude/rules" ]]; then
    mkdir -p "$ws/.claude/rules"
    cp -a "$tree/.claude/rules/." "$ws/.claude/rules/"
  fi
  printf '@.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md\n' > "$ws/CLAUDE.md"
  if [[ -n "${LOA_EVAL_ARM+x}" && -f "$tree/.loa.config.yaml" ]]; then
    cp "$tree/.loa.config.yaml" "$ws/.loa.config.yaml"
  fi
  _sm_evidence mount "skill:$skill"
  return 0
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
resolve_arm_toggles() {
  local arm="$1" suite_file="${2:-}"
  [[ "$arm" =~ ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$ ]] || { _sm_err "invalid arm id '$arm'"; return 2; }
  local found=0 entry=""
  if [[ -n "$suite_file" && -f "$suite_file" ]]; then
    # an unreadable suite file reads as "not declared" (cycle-129 behaviour: baseline still resolves to {})
    entry="$(ARM="$arm" yq -o=json -I=0 '[((.arms // [])[]), ((.ab.arms // [])[])] | map(select(.id == strenv(ARM))) | .[0] // null' "$suite_file" 2>/dev/null)" \
      || entry=""
    [[ -n "$entry" && "$entry" != "null" ]] && found=1
  fi
  if [[ "$found" -eq 0 ]]; then
    [[ "$arm" == "baseline" ]] && { printf '{}'; return 0; }
    _sm_err "arm '$arm' is not declared in ${suite_file:-any suite} (arms[] / ab.arms[])"
    return 2
  fi
  if [[ "$(jq -r '.absent // false' <<<"$entry")" == "true" ]]; then
    _sm_err "arm '$arm' is declared absent in $suite_file (never run): $(jq -r '.evidence // "no evidence"' <<<"$entry")"
    return 2
  fi
  local t
  t="$(jq -c '.toggles // {}' <<<"$entry")"
  jq -e 'type == "object"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$t" || { _sm_err "arm '$arm' toggles are not an object in $suite_file"; return 2; }
  printf '%s' "$t"
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Remove the markdown section that starts at the exact heading line $2 (up to
# the next level-2 heading) from file $1. Prints the number of lines removed.
_sm_drop_md_section() {
  local f="$1" heading="$2" tmpdir="$3" tmp
  tmp="$(mktemp "$tmpdir/.arm.XXXXXX")"
  awk -v h="$heading" '
    $0 == h { skip = 1; n++; next }
    skip && /^## / { skip = 0 }
    skip { n++; next }
    { print }
    END { print n + 0 > "/dev/stderr" }' "$f" > "$tmp" 2> "$tmp.n"
  mv "$tmp" "$f"
  cat "$tmp.n"; rm -f "$tmp.n"
}

# Remove the first blank-line-delimited paragraph of $1 that contains one of
# the needles (tried in order, case-insensitive). Writes the removed text to
# $2; exit 1 when no needle matches.
_sm_drop_paragraph() {
  python3 -I - "$1" "$2" "look for what the review did not" "Confirm the review's demotions independently" <<'PY'
import re, sys
path, out = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
text = open(path, encoding="utf-8").read()
paras = re.split(r"(\n[ \t]*\n)", text)
for needle in sys.argv[3:]:
    for i in range(0, len(paras), 2):
        if needle.lower() in paras[i].lower():
            removed = paras[i]
            # drop the paragraph and the separator that follows it
            del paras[i:i + 2]
            open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8").write("".join(paras))
            open(out, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(removed + "\n")
            sys.exit(0)
sys.exit(1)
PY
}

# Strip every `effort:` line from the YAML frontmatter of file $1 (frontmatter
# = line 1 `---` up to the next `---`). Prints 1 when a line was removed, else 0.
_sm_strip_frontmatter_effort() {
  local f="$1" tmp
  tmp="$(mktemp "$f.XXXXXX")"
  awk '
    NR == 1 && $0 == "---" { fm = 1; print; next }
    fm == 1 && $0 == "---" { fm = 2; print; next }
    fm == 1 && /^effort:/ { n++; next }
    { print }
    END { print (n > 0 ? 1 : 0) > "/dev/stderr" }' "$f" > "$tmp" 2> "$tmp.n"
  cat "$tmp" > "$f"; rm -f "$tmp"
  cat "$tmp.n"; rm -f "$tmp.n"
}

# 0 when file $1's frontmatter still carries an `effort:` line.
_sm_frontmatter_has_effort() {
  awk 'NR == 1 && $0 != "---" { exit 1 } NR > 1 && $0 == "---" { exit 1 } NR > 1 && /^effort:/ { found = 1; exit 0 } END { exit (found ? 0 : 1) }' "$1"
}

_sm_cfg_set_false() {  # _sm_cfg_set_false <cfg> <yq-path>... ; verifies each
  local cfg="$1"; shift
  [[ -f "$cfg" ]] || : > "$cfg"
  local p
  for p in "$@"; do
    P="$p" yq -i 'eval(strenv(P)) = false' "$cfg" 2>/dev/null || return 1
    [[ "$(P="$p" yq -r 'eval(strenv(P))' "$cfg" 2>/dev/null)" == "false" ]] || return 1
  done
  return 0
}

apply_arm_toggles() {
  local ws="$1" toggles="${2:-}" arm="${3:-}"
  [[ -d "$ws" ]] || { _sm_err "apply_arm_toggles: workspace not found: $ws"; return 2; }
  [[ -n "$toggles" ]] || toggles='{}'
  jq -e 'type == "object"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$toggles" || { _sm_err "arm '$arm' toggles are not a JSON object"; return 2; }
  local eval_dir="$ws/.eval"
  mkdir -p "$eval_dir"
  local key val
  while IFS=$'\t' read -r key val; do
    [[ -n "$key" ]] || continue
    if [[ "$key" == "effort" ]]; then
      case "$val" in low|medium|high|xhigh|max) ;; *) _sm_err "arm '$arm' toggle effort=$val (want low|medium|high|xhigh|max)"; return 2 ;; esac
    elif [[ "$val" != "false" ]]; then
      _sm_err "arm '$arm' toggle $key=$val (only false is defined)"; return 2
    fi
    case "$key" in
      companion_voice)
        _sm_cfg_set_false "$ws/.loa.config.yaml" .flatline_protocol.code_review.companion_voice .flatline_protocol.security_audit.companion_voice \
          || { _sm_err "companion_voice toggle did not take effect"; return 2; }
        _sm_evidence companion_voice "flatline_protocol.{code_review,security_audit}.companion_voice=false"
        ;;
      karpathy_block)
        local k="$ws/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md" n
        [[ -f "$k" ]] || { _sm_err "karpathy_block toggle: no sandbox CLAUDE.loa.md"; return 2; }
        n="$(_sm_drop_md_section "$k" '## Karpathy Principles' "$eval_dir")"
        if [[ "${n:-0}" -eq 0 ]] || grep -q '^## Karpathy Principles' "$k"; then
          _sm_err "karpathy_block toggle: no '## Karpathy Principles' section removed"; return 2
        fi
        local cj="$ws/.claude/data/constraints.json" cjn="none"
        if [[ -f "$cj" ]]; then
          # audit r1 DISS-C-008: a failed rewrite is exit 2, not a silent pass; verify afterwards
          jq '(.constraints // []) |= map(select((tostring | test("karpathy"; "i")) | not))' "$cj" > "$cj.tmp" \
            || { rm -f "$cj.tmp"; _sm_err "karpathy_block toggle: constraints.json could not be rewritten"; return 2; }
          mv "$cj.tmp" "$cj"
          cjn="$(jq '[(.constraints // [])[] | select(tostring | test("karpathy"; "i"))] | length' "$cj" 2>/dev/null || echo "?")"
          [[ "$cjn" == "0" ]] || { _sm_err "karpathy_block toggle: constraints.json still carries Karpathy rows ($cjn)"; return 2; }
        fi
        _sm_evidence karpathy_block "removed ${n} lines from CLAUDE.loa.md; constraints.json karpathy rows after: ${cjn}"
        ;;
      rule_files)
        local r gone=""
        for r in stash-safety.md skill-invariants.md; do
          if [[ -e "$ws/.claude/rules/$r" ]]; then rm -f "$ws/.claude/rules/$r"; gone="$gone $r"; fi
          [[ ! -e "$ws/.claude/rules/$r" ]] || { _sm_err "rule_files toggle: $r still present"; return 2; }
        done
        _sm_evidence rule_files "removed:${gone:- none present}"
        ;;
      audit_delta_instruction)
        local s="$ws/.claude/skills/auditing-security/SKILL.md"
        [[ -f "$s" ]] || { _sm_err "audit_delta_instruction toggle: no sandbox auditing-security/SKILL.md"; return 2; }
        _sm_drop_paragraph "$s" "$eval_dir/arm-removed.txt" \
          || { _sm_err "audit_delta_instruction toggle: no delta paragraph found in the sandbox SKILL.md"; return 2; }
        _sm_evidence audit_delta_instruction "removed $(wc -c < "$eval_dir/arm-removed.txt" | tr -d ' ') bytes (.eval/arm-removed.txt)"
        ;;
      loa_mount)
        local p left=""
        for p in .claude CLAUDE.md .loa.config.yaml; do
          if [[ -e "$ws/$p" || -L "$ws/$p" ]]; then left="$left $p"; fi
        done
        [[ -z "$left" ]] || { _sm_err "loa_mount toggle: the sandbox still holds:$left (mount_prompt_surface must be skipped)"; return 2; }
        _sm_evidence loa_mount "none"
        ;;
      effort)
        local f total=0 stripped=0 still=""
        for f in "$ws"/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md; do
          [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue
          total=$((total + 1))
          if [[ "$(_sm_strip_frontmatter_effort "$f")" == "1" ]]; then stripped=$((stripped + 1)); fi
          if _sm_frontmatter_has_effort "$f"; then still="$still ${f#"$ws"/}"; fi
        done
        [[ -z "$still" ]] || { _sm_err "effort toggle: effort: still in the frontmatter of:$still"; return 2; }
        local mc="$ws/.claude/defaults/model-config.yaml" cat_state="absent"
        if [[ -f "$mc" ]]; then
          local nkeys
          nkeys="$(yq '[.. | select(tag == "!!map" and has("default_effort"))] | length' "$mc" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
          [[ "$nkeys" =~ ^[0-9]+$ && "$nkeys" -gt 0 ]] \
            || { _sm_err "effort toggle: no default_effort key in the sandbox model-config.yaml"; return 2; }
          V="$val" yq -i '(.. | select(tag == "!!map" and has("default_effort")) | .default_effort) = strenv(V)' "$mc" \
            || { _sm_err "effort toggle: yq failed on the sandbox model-config.yaml"; return 2; }
          local wrong
          wrong="$(V="$val" yq '[.. | select(tag == "!!map" and has("default_effort")) | select(.default_effort != strenv(V))] | length' "$mc" 2>/dev/null || echo 1)"
          [[ "$wrong" == "0" ]] || { _sm_err "effort toggle: default_effort did not take effect"; return 2; }
          cat_state="default_effort=$val in $nkeys entries"
          if [[ -f "$mc.checksum" ]]; then
            local h
            h="$(_sm_sha256 "$mc" | awk '{print $1}')"
            [[ "$h" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]] || { _sm_err "effort toggle: could not hash model-config.yaml"; return 2; }
            printf '%s\n' "$h" > "$mc.checksum"
            cat_state="$cat_state; .checksum refreshed"
          fi
        fi
        _sm_evidence effort "$val"
        _sm_evidence effort_skills_stripped "$stripped/$total"
        _sm_evidence effort_catalog "$cat_state"
        ;;
      gates)
        _sm_cfg_set_false "$ws/.loa.config.yaml" .flatline_protocol.code_review.enabled .flatline_protocol.security_audit.enabled \
          || { _sm_err "gates toggle did not take effect"; return 2; }
        export LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false
        if [[ -n "${ARM_ENV_FILE:-}" ]]; then printf 'LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false\n' >> "$ARM_ENV_FILE"; fi
        _sm_evidence gates "flatline_protocol.{code_review,security_audit}.enabled=false"
        _sm_evidence arm_env "LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false"
        ;;
      flatline)
        _sm_cfg_set_false "$ws/.loa.config.yaml" .flatline_protocol.enabled \
          || { _sm_err "flatline toggle did not take effect"; return 2; }
        _sm_evidence flatline "flatline_protocol.enabled=false"
        ;;
      sprint_plan)
        _sm_evidence sprint_plan "phase set without PLAN (pipeline executor); no sprint.md materialised"
        ;;
      context_resets)
        _sm_evidence context_resets "implementer phases continue one session (pipeline executor)"
        ;;
      *) _sm_err "arm '$arm' declares unknown toggle '$key'"; return 2 ;;
    esac
  done < <(jq -r 'to_entries[] | [.key, (.value | tostring)] | @tsv' <<<"$toggles")
  return 0
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
regen_sandbox_manifest() {
  local ws="$1"
  [[ -d "$ws" ]] || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: workspace not found: $ws"; return 2; }
  if [[ ! -d "$ws/.claude" ]]; then
    _sm_evidence manifest_sha256 "none"
    return 0
  fi
  local out="$ws/.claude/checksums.json" tool="${EVAL_PROMPT_TREE:-$_SM_REPO_ROOT}/tools/gen-checksums.sh" how="inline"
  if [[ -x "$tool" ]] && git -C "$ws" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 \
     && [[ -n "$(git -C "$ws" ls-files .claude 2>/dev/null | head -1)" ]]; then
    "$tool" --root "$ws" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: $tool --root $ws failed"; return 2; }
    how="gen-checksums.sh"
  else
    local list="$ws/.eval/.manifest-files" sums="$ws/.eval/.manifest-sums"
    mkdir -p "$ws/.eval"
    ( cd "$ws" && find .claude -type f ! -path '.claude/overrides/*' ! -path '.claude/checksums.json' -print ) \
      | LC_ALL=C sort > "$list"
    if grep -q '\\' "$list"; then _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: a path under .claude/ holds a backslash"; rm -f "$list"; return 2; fi
    : > "$sums"
    local -a batch=()
    local f
    while IFS= read -r f; do
      batch+=("$f")
      if [[ ${#batch[@]} -ge 200 ]]; then
        ( cd "$ws" && _sm_sha256 "${batch[@]}" ) >> "$sums" || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: hashing failed"; return 2; }
        batch=()
      fi
    done < "$list"
    if [[ ${#batch[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
      ( cd "$ws" && _sm_sha256 "${batch[@]}" ) >> "$sums" || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: hashing failed"; return 2; }
    fi
    jq -Rn --arg generated "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" '
      {generated: $generated, algorithm: "sha256",
       files: ([inputs | select(length > 0) | capture("^(?<h>[0-9a-f]{64})  (?<p>.+)$") | {key: .p, value: .h}] | from_entries)}' \
      < "$sums" > "$out.tmp" || { rm -f "$out.tmp" "$list" "$sums"; _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: could not write the manifest"; return 2; }
    mv "$out.tmp" "$out"
    rm -f "$list" "$sums"
  fi
  jq -e '.files | type == "object"' "$out" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { _sm_err "regen_sandbox_manifest: $out is not a manifest"; return 2; }
  local digest
  digest="$(_sm_sha256 "$out" | awk '{print $1}')"
  _sm_evidence manifest_files "$(jq '.files | length' "$out") ($how)"
  _sm_evidence manifest_sha256 "$digest"
  return 0
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
check_fixture_path_rule() {
  local dir="$1"
  [[ -d "$dir" ]] || { _sm_err "check_fixture_path_rule: fixture not found: $dir"; return 2; }
  local p bad=""
  for p in .claude CLAUDE.md .loa.config.yaml grimoires .run; do
    if [[ -e "$dir/$p" || -L "$dir/$p" ]]; then bad="$bad $p"; fi
  done
  if [[ -n "$bad" ]]; then
    echo "fixture path rule: $dir holds paths the Loa mount owns:$bad" >&2
    return 2
  fi
  return 0
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
write_sandbox_grimoire() {
  local ws="$1" task="$2" arm="$3" label="${4:-sprint-1}"
  [[ -d "$ws" ]] || { _sm_err "write_sandbox_grimoire: workspace not found: $ws"; return 2; }
  [[ -f "$task" ]] || { _sm_err "write_sandbox_grimoire: task yaml not found: $task"; return 2; }
  [[ "$label" =~ ^sprint-[0-9]{1,4}$ ]] || { _sm_err "write_sandbox_grimoire: invalid sprint label '$label'"; return 2; }
  local tid ttype criterion task_md
  tid="$(yq -r '.id // ""' "$task")"; ttype="$(yq -r '.type // ""' "$task")"
  criterion="$(yq -r '.criterion // ""' "$task")"
  [[ "$tid" =~ ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,63}$ ]] || { _sm_err "write_sandbox_grimoire: task id '$tid' invalid"; return 2; }
  [[ -n "$criterion" && "$criterion" != "null" ]] || { _sm_err "write_sandbox_grimoire: task $tid has no criterion"; return 2; }
  task_md="$(dirname "$task")/TASK.md"
  [[ -f "$task_md" ]] || { _sm_err "write_sandbox_grimoire: no TASK.md beside $task"; return 2; }

  local sprint_plan=true
  if [[ -n "$arm" ]]; then
    local sf="${LOA_EVAL_SUITE_FILE:-$_SM_REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml}" tg
    if tg="$(resolve_arm_toggles "$arm" "$sf" 2>/dev/null)"; then
      [[ "$(jq -r 'if has("sprint_plan") then (.sprint_plan | tostring) else "true" end' <<<"$tg")" == "false" ]] && sprint_plan=false
    fi
  fi

  local g="$ws/grimoires/loa" now
  now="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
  mkdir -p "$g/context" "$g/a2a/$label"
  jq -n --arg now "$now" --arg label "$label" --arg tid "$tid" '
    {version: 1, schema_version: 1, created: $now, last_updated: $now,
     next_sprint_number: 2, global_sprint_counter: 1, active_cycle: "cycle-001",
     cycles: [{id: "cycle-001", label: ("eval task " + $tid), status: "active", created: $now,
               archived: null, archive_path: null, prd: null, sdd: null,
               sprints: [{global_id: 1, local_label: $label, status: "planned", created: $now, completed: null}]}],
     bugfixes: [], bugfix_cycles: []}' > "$g/ledger.json" \
    || { _sm_err "write_sandbox_grimoire: ledger write failed"; return 2; }
  printf '# NOTES\n' > "$g/NOTES.md"
  {
    printf '# Task brief\n\n## Criterion\n\n%s\n\n## Task\n\n' "$criterion"
    cat "$task_md"
  } > "$g/context/task-brief.md"
  local wrote="ledger.json NOTES.md context/task-brief.md a2a/$label/"

  if [[ "$ttype" == "review-catch" && "$sprint_plan" == "true" ]]; then
    {
      printf '# Sprint Plan\n\n## Sprint %s: Review the pull request in pr/\n\n' "${label#sprint-}"
      printf 'The change under review is `pr/head.diff` (unified diff, base to head). The files before the change are under `pr/base/`, after it under `pr/head/`; `pr/PR.md` is the pull request description and is the implementation report for this sprint.\n\n'
      printf '### Tasks\n\n- [x] Task 1.1: the change in `pr/head.diff`\n\n'
      printf '### Review scope\n\nThe gates review `pr/head.diff` (pass `--diff-file pr/head.diff` to the adversarial review). Cite findings as `head/<path>:<line>` with lines from the `pr/head/` files.\n\n'
      printf '## Success Criteria\n\n%s\n' "$criterion"
    } > "$g/sprint.md"
    local prmd="$ws/pr/PR.md" rcfx
    if [[ ! -f "$prmd" ]]; then
      rcfx="$(yq -r '.review_catch.fixture // ""' "$task")"
      case "$rcfx" in *..*|/*) rcfx="" ;; esac
      prmd="$_SM_REPO_ROOT/evals/fixtures/$rcfx/PR.md"
    fi
    [[ -f "$prmd" ]] || { _sm_err "write_sandbox_grimoire: no PR.md for review-catch task $tid"; return 2; }
    { printf '# Implementation Report: %s\n\n' "$label"; cat "$prmd"; } > "$g/a2a/$label/reviewer.md"
    wrote="$wrote sprint.md a2a/$label/reviewer.md"
  fi
  _sm_evidence grimoire "$wrote"
  return 0
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
init_sandbox_beads() {
  local ws="$1" title="${2:-}"
  [[ -d "$ws" ]] || { _sm_err "init_sandbox_beads: workspace not found: $ws"; return 2; }
  [[ -n "$title" ]] || title="eval task"
  local br="${LOA_EVAL_BR_BIN:-br}"
  if command -v "$br" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    ( cd "$ws" && "$br" init --prefix bd --no-daemon >/dev/null 2>&1 && "$br" create "$title" --type task --silent >/dev/null 2>&1 ) \
      || { _sm_err "init_sandbox_beads: br init/create failed in $ws"; return 2; }
    _sm_evidence beads "br"
    return 0
  fi
  local ubs="$ws/.claude/scripts/beads/update-beads-state.sh"
  if [[ -f "$ubs" ]]; then
    PROJECT_ROOT="$ws" bash "$ubs" --opt-out "eval sandbox: br not on PATH" >/dev/null 2>&1 \
      || { _sm_err "init_sandbox_beads: update-beads-state.sh --opt-out failed"; return 2; }
    _sm_evidence beads "opt-out"
    return 0
  fi
  _sm_evidence beads "none"
  return 0
}

# Dockerfile.ablation — container executor image for the cycle-130 component ablation
# (SDD D-4.9 / DEC-0411). Extends Dockerfile.sandbox's pinned base and non-root user
# with the Claude Code CLI, the codex CLI, pytest and bats. It holds NO credentials.
# pipeline-run.sh mounts exactly two host paths: the sandbox read-write at /workspace
# and a per-run writable HOME at /home/evaluser (<run>/meta/home: the codex CLI's
# auth.json/config.toml copies, empty .claude/ and .aws/; the CLI's session store). The
# Bedrock route authenticates from AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK passed in the environment.
# The image's tool versions (below) are the batch's versions: every arm runs here.
#
# Build (no build context is needed; nothing is COPY'd):
#   docker build -t loa-ablation:258 - < evals/harness/Dockerfile.ablation
# Run:
#   evals/harness/pipeline-run.sh --executor container --image loa-ablation:258 …
#   (pipeline-run.sh passes --rm --name --user --network bridge --read-only --tmpfs /tmp
#    --pids-limit 512 --memory 4g --cpus 2 and exactly the two mounts)
#
# Digest pinned 2026-02-11 (same base as Dockerfile.sandbox):
#   docker manifest inspect node:20.11.0-bookworm-slim | jq '.manifests[0].digest'
FROM rust:1-bookworm AS brbuild
RUN cargo install beads_rust --version 0.2.6 --root /opt/br --locked 2>/dev/null || cargo install beads_rust --version 0.2.6 --root /opt/br

FROM node:20.11.0-bookworm-slim@sha256:8ea90c4f037cc3c2f566eb46c53eaac005129113487eda4090058fe554578104 AS base

ARG CLAUDE_CODE_VERSION=2.1.299
ARG CODEX_VERSION=0.162.1
ARG PYTEST_VERSION=9.0.2
ARG BATS_VERSION=v1.13.0

RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    bash \
    git \
    jq \
    python3 \
    python3-pip \
    python3-venv \
    grep \
    diffutils \
    coreutils \
    procps \
    ca-certificates \
    curl \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# yq (mikefarah/yq) with SHA256 integrity verification (as Dockerfile.sandbox)
ARG YQ_VERSION=v4.40.5
ARG YQ_SHA256_AMD64=0d6aaf1cf44a8d18fbc7ed0ef14f735a8df8d2e314c4cc0f0242d35c0a440c95
ARG YQ_SHA256_ARM64=9431f0fa39a0af03a152d7fe19a86e42e9ff28d503ed4a70598f9261ec944a97
RUN arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) && \
    case "$arch" in \
      amd64) yq_arch="amd64"; yq_sha256="${YQ_SHA256_AMD64}" ;; \
      arm64) yq_arch="arm64"; yq_sha256="${YQ_SHA256_ARM64}" ;; \
      *) echo "Unsupported architecture: $arch" && exit 1 ;; \
    esac && \
    curl -fsSL "https://github.com/mikefarah/yq/releases/download/${YQ_VERSION}/yq_linux_${yq_arch}" \
      -o /usr/local/bin/yq && \
    echo "${yq_sha256}  /usr/local/bin/yq" | sha256sum -c - && \
    chmod +x /usr/local/bin/yq

# The two CLIs at the versions the fingerprint pins (exact versions, no ranges).
RUN npm install -g --no-fund --no-audit \
      "@anthropic-ai/claude-code@${CLAUDE_CODE_VERSION}" \
      "@openai/codex@${CODEX_VERSION}" \
    && npm cache clean --force

# pytest for Python fixtures (bookworm's pip is externally managed)
RUN pip3 install --no-cache-dir --break-system-packages "pytest==${PYTEST_VERSION}"
# cheval's declared dependencies (.claude/adapters/pyproject.toml: dependencies + the `full` extra),
# so the sandbox gates (adversarial-review.sh, flatline-orchestrator.sh) can dispatch (lead, DEC-0482)
RUN pip3 install --no-cache-dir --break-system-packages "rfc8785>=0.1.4" "jsonschema>=4.21" "pyyaml>=6.0" "httpx[http2]>=0.24.0"

# bats-core at the pinned tag
RUN git clone --depth 1 --branch "${BATS_VERSION}" https://github.com/bats-core/bats-core.git /tmp/bats-core && \
    /tmp/bats-core/install.sh /usr/local && \
    rm -rf /tmp/bats-core

# Disable npm lifecycle scripts for anything the agent installs later
RUN npm config set ignore-scripts true

# Non-root user (as Dockerfile.sandbox). At run time /home/evaluser is replaced by the
# per-run HOME bind mount and the process runs as the host uid (--user).
RUN groupadd -r evaluser && useradd -r -g evaluser -d /home/evaluser -s /bin/bash evaluser
# No beads (br) in the image: beads_rust 0.2.6 is not on crates.io and the host binary needs glibc 2.38+; the sandbox
# materialiser writes the beads opt-out marker (LOA_EVAL_BR_BIN unset/absent), so every arm runs the skills'
# markdown fallback alike (lead, Sprint 258).
RUN mkdir -p /home/evaluser/.aws /home/evaluser/.claude /home/evaluser/.codex /workspace && \
    chown -R evaluser:evaluser /home/evaluser /workspace

ENV TZ=UTC
ENV LC_ALL=C
ENV HOME=/home/evaluser
ENV NPM_CONFIG_IGNORE_SCRIPTS=true
ENV CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK=1

USER evaluser
WORKDIR /workspace

# Health check — every tool the fingerprint names is present
RUN bash --version && git --version && jq --version && node --version && \
    python3 --version && python3 -m pytest --version && yq --version && \
    bats --version && claude --version && codex --version && \
    echo "All tools verified"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# spend.sh — cycle-130 cycle spend (SDD §5.11, PRD FR-2, DEC-0363)
#
# Prints what the cycle has spent: the run rows' cost_usd plus the operator
# cost ledger's cost_micro_usd since the kickoff timestamp, against the cap.
#
# Usage:
#   spend.sh [--since TS] [--runs FILE…] [--ledger FILE] [--cap USD]
#            [--reserve USD] [--json]
#
#   --since TS     ledger rows with ts >= TS count (default 2026-10-14T13:50:00Z,
#                  the cycle-130 kickoff); run rows are the cycle's own and all count
#   --runs FILE…   run-row files (JSONL, `cost_usd` per row); repeatable, and every
#                  following non-option argument is a file too. Default:
#                  grimoires/loa/reports/ablation-2.0/runs.jsonl plus every
#                  evals/results/ablation-2.0/*/rows.jsonl that exists. A row whose
#                  run_id was already counted from another file is counted once.
#   --ledger FILE  cost ledger (JSONL, `ts`, `cost_micro_usd`; default .run/cost-ledger.jsonl)
#   --cap USD      cycle cap (default: evals.ablation.cycle_cap_usd in .loa.config.yaml,
#                  else caps.cycle_usd in evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml, else 1500)
#   --reserve USD  reserve (default caps.reserve_usd in the suite file, else 250)
#   --json         one JSON object: total_usd, runs_usd, ledger_usd, since, cap_usd,
#                  headroom_usd, reserve_usd, runs_files, ledger_file, runs_rows,
#                  runs_rows_deduped, ledger_rows, skipped_lines
#
# Output: cycle spend USD T (runs R + ledger L since S); cap C; headroom H; reserve V
#   headroom = cap - total (negative when over). Default files that do not exist
#   count as zero; a malformed line is skipped and counted (stderr note).
#
# Exit: 0 printed; 1 a named file (or an existing default) is unreadable; 2 usage.
# Tested by evals/tests/spend.bats.
# =============================================================================
set -euo pipefail
export LC_ALL=C

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
SINCE="2026-10-14T13:50:00Z"
LEDGER="" CAP="" RESERVE="" JSON=false
RUNS=()

usage() { sed -n '2,/^# =====.*$/p' "$0" | sed -n '2,32p' | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//' >&2; exit 2; }
die() { echo "spend: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
num_ok() { [[ "$1" =~ ^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$ ]]; }

while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
  case "$1" in
    --since) SINCE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --runs)
      [[ -n "${2:-}" && "${2:-}" != --* ]] || die "--runs needs at least one file"
      shift
      while [[ $# -gt 0 && "$1" != --* ]]; do RUNS+=("$1"); shift; done ;;
    --ledger) LEDGER="${2:-}"; [[ -n "$LEDGER" ]] || die "--ledger needs a file"; shift 2 ;;
    --cap) CAP="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --reserve) RESERVE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    --json) JSON=true; shift ;;
    --help|-h) usage ;;
    *) die "unknown option: $1 (see --help)" ;;
  esac
done
[[ "$SINCE" =~ ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}(T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(:[0-9]{2}(\.[0-9]+)?)?(Z|[+-][0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2})?)?$ ]] \
  || die "--since must be an ISO-8601 timestamp (e.g. 2026-10-14T13:50:00Z)"
command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "missing tool: python3"

SUITE="$REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml"
yq_num() {  # yq_num <expr> <file> — a number or empty
  local v
  [[ -f "$2" ]] && command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 0
  v="$(yq -r "$1 // \"\"" "$2" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  num_ok "$v" && printf '%s' "$v"
  return 0
}
if [[ -z "$CAP" ]]; then
  CAP="$(yq_num '.evals.ablation.cycle_cap_usd' "$REPO_ROOT/.loa.config.yaml")"
  [[ -n "$CAP" ]] || CAP="$(yq_num '.caps.cycle_usd' "$SUITE")"
  [[ -n "$CAP" ]] || CAP=1500
fi
if [[ -z "$RESERVE" ]]; then
  RESERVE="$(yq_num '.caps.reserve_usd' "$SUITE")"
  [[ -n "$RESERVE" ]] || RESERVE=250
fi
num_ok "$CAP" || die "--cap must be a non-negative number"
num_ok "$RESERVE" || die "--reserve must be a non-negative number"

# Explicit files must be readable; defaults are optional (absent = zero).
if [[ ${#RUNS[@]} -eq 0 ]]; then
  [[ -e "$REPO_ROOT/grimoires/loa/reports/ablation-2.0/runs.jsonl" ]] && RUNS+=("$REPO_ROOT/grimoires/loa/reports/ablation-2.0/runs.jsonl")
  for f in "$REPO_ROOT"/evals/results/ablation-2.0/*/rows.jsonl; do [[ -e "$f" ]] && RUNS+=("$f"); done
fi
EXPLICIT_LEDGER=true
if [[ -z "$LEDGER" ]]; then
  EXPLICIT_LEDGER=false
  LEDGER="$REPO_ROOT/.run/cost-ledger.jsonl"
fi
for f in ${RUNS[@]+"${RUNS[@]}"}; do
  [[ -f "$f" && -r "$f" ]] || { echo "spend: run-row file unreadable: $f" >&2; exit 1; }
done
if [[ -e "$LEDGER" || "$EXPLICIT_LEDGER" == "true" ]]; then
  [[ -f "$LEDGER" && -r "$LEDGER" ]] || { echo "spend: ledger unreadable: $LEDGER" >&2; exit 1; }
else
  LEDGER=""
fi

python3 -I - "$SINCE" "$CAP" "$RESERVE" "$JSON" "$LEDGER" ${RUNS[@]+"${RUNS[@]}"} <<'PY'
import json, sys
from datetime import datetime, timezone

since_s, cap, reserve, as_json, ledger = sys.argv[1], float(sys.argv[2]), float(sys.argv[3]), sys.argv[4] == "true", sys.argv[5]
runs_files = sys.argv[6:]

def ts(s):
    s = s.strip()
    if len(s) == 10:
        s += "T00:00:00Z"
    d = datetime.fromisoformat(s.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
    return d if d.tzinfo else d.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)

since = ts(since_s)
skipped = 0
runs_usd, runs_rows, dedup = 0.0, 0, 0
seen = set()
for f in runs_files:
    for line in open(f, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"):
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        try:
            r = json.loads(line)
            c = float(r.get("cost_usd") or 0)
        except (ValueError, TypeError, AttributeError):
            skipped += 1
            continue
        rid = r.get("run_id")
        key = rid if isinstance(rid, str) and rid else None
        if key is not None and key in seen:
            dedup += 1
            continue
        if key is not None:
            seen.add(key)
        runs_usd += c
        runs_rows += 1

ledger_usd, ledger_rows = 0.0, 0
if ledger:
    for line in open(ledger, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"):
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        try:
            r = json.loads(line)
            if ts(str(r["ts"])) < since:
                continue
            ledger_usd += float(r.get("cost_micro_usd") or 0) / 1e6
            ledger_rows += 1
        except (ValueError, TypeError, KeyError, AttributeError):
            skipped += 1

total = runs_usd + ledger_usd
headroom = cap - total
if skipped:
    print(f"spend: skipped {skipped} malformed line(s)", file=sys.stderr)
def n(x):
    x = round(x, 4)
    return int(x) if x == int(x) else x
if as_json:
    print(json.dumps({
        "total_usd": n(total), "runs_usd": n(runs_usd), "ledger_usd": n(ledger_usd),
        "since": since_s, "cap_usd": n(cap), "headroom_usd": n(headroom), "reserve_usd": n(reserve),
        "runs_files": runs_files, "ledger_file": ledger or None, "runs_rows": runs_rows,
        "runs_rows_deduped": dedup, "ledger_rows": ledger_rows, "skipped_lines": skipped}, sort_keys=True))
else:
    def money(x): return f"{x:,.2f}"
    def whole(x): return f"{x:,.0f}" if x == int(x) else f"{x:,.2f}"
    print(f"cycle spend USD {money(total)} (runs {money(runs_usd)} + ledger {money(ledger_usd)} since {since_s}); "
          f"cap {whole(cap)}; headroom {money(headroom)}; reserve {whole(reserve)}")
PY

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# tools/gen-checksums.sh — cycle-130 FR-1 (#1267; SDD §5.1, DEC-0368)
#
# Writes the System Zone integrity manifest `.claude/checksums.json` from the
# TRACKED `.claude/` tree only. The legacy generators (mount-loa.sh and
# update.sh `generate_checksums`) walk the working tree with `find`, so build,
# cache and runtime artefacts (`__pycache__`, `.pytest_cache`, `node_modules`,
# `.run/`) that exist only on the generating machine end up in the manifest and
# read as Missing on every fresh mount. This generator lists
#
#   git -C ROOT ls-files -z -- .claude
#
# minus every path under `.claude/overrides/` (user-owned) and minus the
# manifest itself (`.claude/checksums.json`), hashes each with
# `sha256_portable` (.claude/scripts/compat-lib.sh) and writes
#
#   {"generated": "<UTC ISO-8601>", "algorithm": "sha256",
#    "files": {"<path>": "<sha256 hex>", ...}}
#
# pretty-printed by jq (2-space), keys in `LC_ALL=C` byte order. Two runs on
# the same tree are byte-identical except `generated`. The working-tree content
# of each tracked path is hashed (an unstaged edit is reflected); a tracked
# path deleted from the working tree is skipped with a warning on stderr.
#
# Usage:
#   tools/gen-checksums.sh [--root DIR] [--out FILE]   # (re)generate
#   tools/gen-checksums.sh --check [--root DIR] [--out FILE]
#
# Options:
#   --root DIR   repository work tree to read (default: the git top level of
#                the current directory)
#   --out FILE   manifest path (default: ROOT/.claude/checksums.json). With
#                --check this is the committed manifest that is compared.
#   --check      regenerate to a temp file and compare its `files` map with
#                the manifest at --out; nothing is written
#   -h, --help   this text
#
# Exit codes:
#   0  generated, or --check: the `files` maps are identical
#   1  --check: drift (the first ten differing paths, each labelled added /
#      removed / changed, on stderr) or the manifest is absent / not JSON
#   2  usage error, ROOT is not a git work tree, or a tracked path name that
#      cannot be represented safely (newline, tab or backslash)
# =============================================================================
set -euo pipefail
export LC_ALL=C

SELF_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
# shellcheck source=../.claude/scripts/compat-lib.sh
source "${SELF_DIR}/../.claude/scripts/compat-lib.sh"

usage() { sed -n '/^# Usage:/,/^# =====/p' "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" | sed -e '$d' -e 's/^# \{0,1\}//'; }
die2() { echo "gen-checksums: $*" >&2; exit 2; }

MANIFEST_REL=".claude/checksums.json"
ROOT=""
OUT=""
CHECK=0
while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
  case "$1" in
    --check) CHECK=1; shift ;;
    --root)
      [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || die2 "--root requires a directory"
      ROOT="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --out)
      [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || die2 "--out requires a file path"
      OUT="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    -h|--help) usage; exit 0 ;;
    *) die2 "unknown argument: $1 (see --help)" ;;
  esac
done

if [[ -z "$ROOT" ]]; then
  ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || die2 "not inside a git work tree (use --root DIR)"
fi
[[ -d "$ROOT" ]] || die2 "--root is not a directory: $ROOT"
ROOT="$(cd "$ROOT" && pwd -P)"
[[ "$(git -C "$ROOT" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree 2>/dev/null || true)" == "true" ]] \
  || die2 "not a git work tree: $ROOT"
[[ -n "$OUT" ]] || OUT="${ROOT}/${MANIFEST_REL}"

TMP_DIR="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/gen-checksums.XXXXXX")"
cleanup() { rm -rf "$TMP_DIR"; }
trap cleanup EXIT

# --- 1. the tracked set (NUL-safe, C-sorted, overrides and manifest removed) --
files=()
while IFS= read -r -d '' path; do
  case "$path" in
    .claude/overrides/*|"$MANIFEST_REL") continue ;;
  esac
  case "$path" in
    *$'\n'*|*$'\t'*|*\\*) die2 "refusing a tracked path with a newline, tab or backslash: $(printf '%q' "$path")" ;;
  esac
  if [[ ! -f "${ROOT}/${path}" ]]; then
    # A gitlink, a dangling symlink or a path deleted in the working tree.
    echo "gen-checksums: warning: tracked path not a file in the working tree, skipped: $path" >&2
    continue
  fi
  files+=("$path")
done < <(git -C "$ROOT" ls-files -z -- .claude | sort -z)

# --- 2. hash in chunks (one sha256 process per 400 paths, order preserved) ----
TSV="${TMP_DIR}/files.tsv"
: > "$TSV"
n=${#files[@]}
i=0
while [[ $i -lt $n ]]; do
  chunk=("${files[@]:i:400}")
  hashes=()
  while IFS= read -r line; do
    hashes+=("${line%% *}")
  done < <(cd "$ROOT" && sha256_portable "${chunk[@]}")
  [[ ${#hashes[@]} -eq ${#chunk[@]} ]] || die2 "sha256 returned ${#hashes[@]} digests for ${#chunk[@]} paths"
  j=0
  while [[ $j -lt ${#chunk[@]} ]]; do
    [[ "${hashes[j]}" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]] || die2 "unexpected sha256 output for ${chunk[j]}"
    printf '%s\t%s\n' "${chunk[j]}" "${hashes[j]}" >> "$TSV"
    j=$((j + 1))
  done
  i=$((i + 400))
done
[[ $n -gt 0 ]] || echo "gen-checksums: warning: no tracked files under .claude in $ROOT" >&2

GEN="${TMP_DIR}/checksums.json"
jq -Rn --arg generated "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" '
  {generated: $generated, algorithm: "sha256",
   files: ([inputs | select(length > 0) | split("\t") | {key: .[0], value: .[1]}] | from_entries)}
' < "$TSV" > "$GEN"

# --- 3a. write ----------------------------------------------------------------
if [[ $CHECK -eq 0 ]]; then
  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$OUT")"
  chmod 0644 "$GEN"
  # mv replaces a symlinked manifest instead of writing through it.
  mv -f "$GEN" "$OUT"
  echo "gen-checksums: wrote $n entries to $OUT" >&2
  exit 0
fi

# --- 3b. --check --------------------------------------------------------------
if [[ ! -f "$OUT" ]]; then
  echo "gen-checksums: --check: manifest not found: $OUT (run tools/gen-checksums.sh)" >&2
  exit 1
fi
if ! jq -e '.files | type == "object"' "$OUT" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "gen-checksums: --check: manifest is not JSON with a files object: $OUT" >&2
  exit 1
fi
DIFF="${TMP_DIR}/diff.txt"
jq -rn --slurpfile old "$OUT" --slurpfile new "$GEN" '
  ($old[0].files) as $o | ($new[0].files) as $n |
  ( [ $n | keys[] | . as $p | select($o | has($p) | not) | {p: $p, k: "added"} ]
  + [ $o | keys[] | . as $p | select($n | has($p) | not) | {p: $p, k: "removed"} ]
  + [ $n | keys[] | . as $p | select(($o | has($p)) and $o[$p] != $n[$p]) | {p: $p, k: "changed"} ] )
  | sort_by(.p) | .[] | "\(.k): \(.p)"
' > "$DIFF"
count=$(wc -l < "$DIFF" | tr -d ' ')
if [[ "$count" -eq 0 ]]; then
  echo "gen-checksums: --check: OK ($n entries match $OUT)" >&2
  exit 0
fi
echo "gen-checksums: --check: DRIFT — $count path(s) differ between $OUT and the tracked tree:" >&2
sed -n '1,10s/^/  /p' "$DIFF" >&2
[[ "$count" -le 10 ]] || echo "  ... and $((count - 10)) more" >&2
echo "gen-checksums: regenerate with: bash tools/gen-checksums.sh" >&2
exit 1

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# tools/check-manifest-paths.sh — cycle-130 FR-1 (#1267; SDD §5.2, DEC-0368)
#
# CI gate for the System Zone integrity manifest: every path listed in
# `.claude/checksums.json` must be TRACKED (`git ls-files -- .claude`) and
# PRESENT in the working tree. A manifest generated by walking a dirty tree
# (the #1267 class) lists build, cache and runtime artefacts that no fresh
# mount has, so every downstream `check-loa.sh` reports them as Missing.
#
# Offenders are grouped on stderr:
#   untracked  — listed in the manifest, not in `git ls-files`; each carries a
#                DIAGNOSTIC class (first match wins):
#                  __pycache__ | .pytest_cache | node_modules | .run
#                      (a path component of that name)
#                  .pyc   (name ends in .pyc)
#                  .lock  (name ends in .lock)
#                  other
#   missing    — tracked, but absent from the working tree
# The classes label untracked offenders only: a TRACKED path is never flagged
# for its name (a committed `.lock` fixture is legitimate).
#
# Last line on stdout:
#   manifest-paths: N entries, M untracked (class=count, ...), K missing
#
# Usage:
#   tools/check-manifest-paths.sh [--manifest FILE] [--root DIR]
#
# Options:
#   --root DIR       repository work tree (default: the git top level of the
#                    current directory)
#   --manifest FILE  manifest to check (default: ROOT/.claude/checksums.json)
#   -h, --help       this text
#
# Exit codes:
#   0  every manifest path is tracked and present
#   1  at least one untracked or missing path (listed on stderr)
#   2  usage error, ROOT is not a git work tree, or the manifest is absent or
#      not JSON with a `files` object
# =============================================================================
set -euo pipefail
export LC_ALL=C

usage() { sed -n '/^# Usage:/,/^# =====/p' "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" | sed -e '$d' -e 's/^# \{0,1\}//'; }
die2() { echo "check-manifest-paths: $*" >&2; exit 2; }

ROOT=""
MANIFEST=""
while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
  case "$1" in
    --root)
      [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || die2 "--root requires a directory"
      ROOT="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --manifest)
      [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || die2 "--manifest requires a file path"
      MANIFEST="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    -h|--help) usage; exit 0 ;;
    *) die2 "unknown argument: $1 (see --help)" ;;
  esac
done

if [[ -z "$ROOT" ]]; then
  ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || die2 "not inside a git work tree (use --root DIR)"
fi
[[ -d "$ROOT" ]] || die2 "--root is not a directory: $ROOT"
ROOT="$(cd "$ROOT" && pwd -P)"
[[ "$(git -C "$ROOT" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree 2>/dev/null || true)" == "true" ]] \
  || die2 "not a git work tree: $ROOT"
[[ -n "$MANIFEST" ]] || MANIFEST="${ROOT}/.claude/checksums.json"
[[ -f "$MANIFEST" ]] || die2 "manifest not found: $MANIFEST"
jq -e '.files | type == "object"' "$MANIFEST" >/dev/null 2>&1 \
  || die2 "manifest is not JSON with a files object: $MANIFEST"

TMP_DIR="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/check-manifest-paths.XXXXXX")"
cleanup() { rm -rf "$TMP_DIR"; }
trap cleanup EXIT

# Both lists newline-separated and C-sorted. A path with a newline cannot be
# represented in either list; gen-checksums.sh refuses to emit one.
git -C "$ROOT" ls-files -- .claude | sort -u > "${TMP_DIR}/tracked"
jq -r '.files | keys[]' "$MANIFEST" | sort -u > "${TMP_DIR}/listed"
comm -23 "${TMP_DIR}/listed" "${TMP_DIR}/tracked" > "${TMP_DIR}/untracked"
comm -12 "${TMP_DIR}/listed" "${TMP_DIR}/tracked" > "${TMP_DIR}/both"

classify() {
  local p="$1"
  if [[ "$p" =~ (^|/)(__pycache__|\.pytest_cache|node_modules|\.run)(/|$) ]]; then
    printf '%s' "${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
  elif [[ "$p" == *.pyc ]]; then
    printf '.pyc'
  elif [[ "$p" == *.lock ]]; then
    printf '.lock'
  else
    printf 'other'
  fi
}

# Classified untracked offenders: "<class>\t<path>"
: > "${TMP_DIR}/untracked.cls"
while IFS= read -r p; do
  [[ -n "$p" ]] || continue
  printf '%s\t%s\n' "$(classify "$p")" "$p" >> "${TMP_DIR}/untracked.cls"
done < "${TMP_DIR}/untracked"

: > "${TMP_DIR}/missing"
while IFS= read -r p; do
  [[ -n "$p" ]] || continue
  [[ -e "${ROOT}/${p}" ]] || printf '%s\n' "$p" >> "${TMP_DIR}/missing"
done < "${TMP_DIR}/both"

entries=$(wc -l < "${TMP_DIR}/listed" | tr -d ' ')
n_untracked=$(wc -l < "${TMP_DIR}/untracked.cls" | tr -d ' ')
n_missing=$(wc -l < "${TMP_DIR}/missing" | tr -d ' ')

class_summary=""
if [[ "$n_untracked" -gt 0 ]]; then
  echo "check-manifest-paths: untracked manifest paths (not in git ls-files -- .claude), by class:" >&2
  for cls in __pycache__ .pytest_cache node_modules .run .pyc .lock other; do
    c=$(awk -F'\t' -v c="$cls" '$1 == c' "${TMP_DIR}/untracked.cls" | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
    [[ "$c" -gt 0 ]] || continue
    class_summary="${class_summary:+${class_summary}, }${cls}=${c}"
    echo "  [${cls}] ${c} path(s):" >&2
    awk -F'\t' -v c="$cls" '$1 == c { print "    " $2 }' "${TMP_DIR}/untracked.cls" >&2
  done
fi
if [[ "$n_missing" -gt 0 ]]; then
  echo "check-manifest-paths: tracked manifest paths absent from the working tree:" >&2
  sed 's/^/    /' "${TMP_DIR}/missing" >&2
fi

echo "manifest-paths: ${entries} entries, ${n_untracked} untracked${class_summary:+ (${class_summary})}, ${n_missing} missing"
if [[ "$n_untracked" -gt 0 || "$n_missing" -gt 0 ]]; then
  echo "check-manifest-paths: FAIL — regenerate with: bash tools/gen-checksums.sh" >&2
  exit 1
fi
exit 0
